 We request that Shopee and Lazada stop selling unlicensed Dáng Sen food products.
 The Food Safety Department (Ministry of Health) has requested Shopee and Lazada to stop selling and remove information about Dáng Sen food products because the products have not yet been granted a Certificate of Registration for Product Announcement.
 Báo Nhân dân • 12/11/2026 Follow Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e Add Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e 0 Dáng Sen weight loss food is sold on e-commerce platforms. (Screenshot) On November 12th, the Food Safety Department ( Ministry of Health ) announced that its leaders had signed and issued six official documents regarding the handling of advertising and business information related to Dáng Sen food products.
 Official letter sent to the Hanoi City Food Safety and Hygiene Sub-Department, the Hung Yen Provincial Food Safety and Hygiene Sub-Department; Lazada Vietnam E-commerce Company Limited; Shopee Company Limited; the Department of E-commerce and Digital Economy ( Ministry of Industry and Trade ); and the Department of Broadcasting, Television and Electronic Information (Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism).
 We request that Hung Yen and Hanoi inspect the production and distribution facilities.
 According to information from the Food Safety Department, through post-inspection of the implementation of regulations on registration of declarations and self-declarations, production, and business of functional foods, the Food Safety Department discovered that the food product Dáng Sen, being advertised and sold on social media platforms (Facebook) and e-commerce platforms (Shopee, Lazada), claims to have weight-loss effects.
 Specifically at this address:
 - https://www.facebook.com/share/r/17zRNSMh2K;
 - https://shopee.vn/-Combo-3-Tr%C3%A0-D%C3%A1ng-Sen-L%C3%A1-Sen-Tr%E1%BA%A1ch-T%E1%BA%A3-T%C3%A1o-M%C3%A8o-Tr%E1%BA%A7n-B%C3%AC-%C4%90an-S%C3%A2n-H%E1%BB%99p-35-T%C3%BAi-L %E1%BB%8Dc-i.1491332545.52805794107?extraParams=%7B%22display_model_id%22%3A38052480 3318%2C%22model_selection_logic%22%3A3%7D&image_ids=vn-11134207-81ztc-ml7bpcoymuwyde;
 You may also like - https://www.lazada.vn/products/pdp-i3081910173-s14796560590.html?;
 However, the Food Safety Department stated that this product has not been granted a Product Registration Certificate; the product is manufactured by Thai Hung Import-Export Trading Investment Joint Stock Company, located at plot number 10, map sheet number 19, Ben Hiep village, Minh Tho commune, Hung Yen province, and distributed by Nam Y Duong Co., Ltd., located at 13H1 Tran Kim Xuyen Street, Yen Hoa ward, Hanoi city.
 The Food Safety Department requests the Hung Yen Provincial Food Safety and Hygiene Sub-Department to urgently verify and inspect the production, business, and advertising activities of Dang Sen food products at Thai Hung Company.
 In Hanoi, the Department requested the City's Food Safety and Hygiene Sub-Department to verify and inspect the business operations and product advertising of Nam Y Duong Company.
 The Department requested that the two localities take strict action if any violations are detected and send the results to the Department before November 30th.
 The two e-commerce platforms must submit their reports by November 20th.
 The Food Safety Department has requested Shopee Vietnam Co., Ltd. and Lazada Vietnam E-commerce Co., Ltd. to immediately cease business operations, remove information about Dang Sen food products, and submit a written report to the Department before November 20, 2026.
 The Department also requested the two businesses to urgently review their functional food business activities on the platform, and only sell products that have been granted a Certificate of Acceptance of Product Declaration Registration or have been published on the Food Safety Data Information System as prescribed.
 You may also like At the same time, the Food Safety Department requested the Department of E-commerce and Digital Economy (Ministry of Industry and Trade) to continue notifying Shopee, Lazada, and the vendors on these two platforms, requesting them to cease business operations, remove information about the products, and handle the matter according to the law .
 The Food Safety Department also requested the Department of Broadcasting, Television and Electronic Information (Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism) to remove information about the Dáng Sen product from Facebook and handle any violations according to regulations.
 Do Thoa
